args.body: Use the existing SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-PREVIEW-RECONCILIATION mission and an actual valid lease. Read the committed three-way-result.json if available. A clean reversible merge is technical evidence only. Confirm release scope with the private-quote changes owner before staging any combined release. If scope is agreed, verify the merged copy and exact archive link, obtain the dry-run digest, and hand it to an eligible independent reviewer. If the merge conflicts or scope remains unresolved, close with the already verified standalone fallback and a lesson after reading the committed evidence. Keep the shared site and public deployment untouched unless the applicable release prerequisites are met.

description: The SQLite instructor archive ran successfully from a clean extraction, and its placement patch applied to the captured live page. The same patch failed on the shared candidate, which contains separate private-quote edits. Test a three-way merge in temporary storage and preserve the verified standalone preview if the changes conflict or their owners have yet to agree on release scope. Public placement depends on that scope decision and independent approval of the exact release digest. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
